_doc: Ledger of external sources used by the FIGURES part (figure models). One row per source; claims lists exactly what was taken from it. Nothing else in src/figures3d is sourced: every other dimension is plausible-procedural (data/figures3d/TIERS.json).

entries.title: Investigations in the military and anthropological statistics of American soldiers (B. A. Gould, U.S. Sanitary Commission, New York: Hurd and Houghton, 1869)
entries.where: Internet Archive item investigationsi00goulgoog (Google scan; metadata year 1869, flagged not in copyright); full text https://archive.org/stream/investigationsi00goulgoog/investigationsi00goulgoog_djvu.txt (918,209 characters)
entries.licence: public domain (US publication of 1869; the Internet Archive item is marked not in copyright)
entries.how_read: read through the WebFetch tool in 100,000-character windows (offsets 0, 120000, 560000, 660000, 760000); NOT downloaded to disk, so no file hash exists (sha256: not recorded); the figures below were returned by the fetch tool's summariser with the running-header page numbers, which can be a page off: VERIFY against the scan before anything is called documented

claims_used.claim: mean height of the white soldiers measured: 67.240 in (1.708 m)
claims_used.used_for: stature scale of the instance record: the rig is 1.73 m, the scale now spans 0.93-1.045 with mean 0.9875 so the population mean is 1.708 m

claims_used.claim: mean girth of neck (usual vigor, nearly 9,300 men): 13.638 in (0.346 m); mean breadth of neck 4.22 in (0.107 m)
claims_used.used_for: neck of the head part: elliptical, girth 0.346 m at mid height (tested within 12 percent)

claims_used.claim: length of head and neck (stature minus height to the 7th cervical vertebra) as a proportion of stature: 0.1481 for 10,876 white soldiers (later series; 0.1488 for 7,904 earlier series); in inches about 9.94
claims_used.used_for: head and neck proportion of the figure (model: 0.151, 2 percent above)

claims_used.claim: mean distance between the acromion tips 12.781 in (0.325 m)
claims_used.used_for: cross-check only; the shoulder width of the body table was NOT changed in this round

lookups_failed: head circumference, breadth and length in inches: the chapter promised for the head ('Dimensions and Proportions of Head', listed in the table of contents) was not found in the windows read (the remaining text from offset 860000 was not read); the head dimensions of the model (0.153 x 0.194 x 0.224 m) therefore remain plausible-procedural and agree only with the head-and-neck proportion above
entries.tier: inferred (a retrieved public-domain primary source, read through a summarising tool, not yet verified against the scan)
entries.register: EG-FIG-0008 (dimensions): note updated in FIGURES3D-NOTES section 9.10

entries.title: ACWII (Napoleon: Total War American Civil War mod): ACW.zip, assets by the mod author ACW_Primergy and team
entries.where: ACW.zip (36 entries, 21 PFH0 packs), provided by the owner; scratch copy outside the repository; not published here. Subversion origin recorded in the pack data: https://subversion.assembla.com/svn/empire_american_civil_war.4 (uuid 4ca84c4f-01e6-4a0a-bfcb-691c0f47ad24), committer ACW_Primergy, 2011-05-21 to 2011-11-09; mod_details.lua 'ACW2 - 2.0 (Dev Ver)'.
entries.licence: owner-reported verbal permission from the mod author, 2026-11-11; no written text on file
entries.licence_basis_note: The owner stated in chat on 2026-11-11 that the licence was verified by phone with the mod maker and ordered 'use the acw models' (decision log DEC-DELEG-F). The mod author can license only files he made, so base-game (Napoleon / Creative Assembly) assets inside the packs are excluded and each file is decided by evidence; an unclear file is excluded. A Subversion committer record is evidence of who committed a file, not proof of who created it.
entries.credit: ACWII mod by ACW_Primergy and team (used with the author's permission)
entries.how_read: unpacked into a scratch directory with tools/bt/acw/pfh0.py and parsed with python3 -I; the launcher exe and every other file in the archive were never executed; no site was visited
entries.shipped: docs/battle-theatre/app/data/figures3d/acw/ : 24 WebP texture sheets (8 mod-painted Confederate shell-jacket variants x diffuse, normal, gloss; 1,795,040 bytes), manifest.json (every file of 2,200 listed with sha256, evidence and reason codes), swatches.json, unit-map.json, credits.json

claims_used.claim: mean colour of 8 mod-painted Confederate shell-jacket texture sheets (committer ACW_Primergy, rev 96, 2011-09-10, md5 equal to the committed bytes)
claims_used.used_for: lead swatches only (F-ACW-SWATCH, plausible-procedural, gap EG-FIG-0011); not evidence of any 1863 garment

claims_used.claim: mod uniform tables Gettysburg_Union_Uniforms (444 rows) and Gettysburg_Confed_Uniforms (355 rows) join regiment keys to uniform variants
claims_used.used_for: unit-map.json: 77 lead-derived links with their gap (F-ACW-UNIT-LINK, EG-FIG-0011); never used as dress evidence

entries.excluded_summary: no mesh shipped: 85 soldier/officer/general meshes carry base-game sub-mesh names; the remaining meshes have no Subversion record, are placeholders, are unverified or are out of scope (codes in manifest.json); see EG-FIG-0010 and EG-FIG-0012
